traceability.notes: The specification docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md is unchanged from the previous assessment. The core ESLint rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation are implemented using a shared helper (require-story-core.ts) that: - Detects the required set of function-like constructs with a shared DEFAULT_SCOPE excluding arrow functions by default (REQ-FUNCTION-DETECTION). - Uses robust JSDoc/comment-based parsing utilities (tested extensively) for @story and @req detection (REQ-JSDOC-PARSING). - Enforces that in-scope functions must have @story/@req respectively, with mirrored behavior across both rules (REQ-ANNOTATION-REQUIRED). - Exposes and honors common configuration for scope and exportPriority, verified by symmetric tests for both rules (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE, REQ-EXPORT-PRIORITY). - Reports errors on the function name/closest equivalent and provides suggestions, giving clear, actionable feedback (REQ-ERROR-LOCATION and User Experience criterion). - Fully supports TypeScript-specific constructs TSDeclareFunction and TSMethodSignature with matching behavior and tests in both rules (REQ-TYPESCRIPT-SUPPORT, Integration criterion). All referenced test suites pass in the current run, and dedicated rule documentation exists. Therefore, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are fully implemented and verified.
